originalRequest: Google quick-login that worked about one to two hours ago now reaches a Google 400 page; identify and safely fix the cause.
scope: PlanFlow-AppsInToss Google Calendar OAuth request and its installed-runtime configuration; no credentials, account data, or Google Cloud changes without specific authority.

roles.assignment: Read-only authoritative runtime and Google OAuth investigation.
roles.testEvidence: Flutter test was started but no final result was obtained.
roles.summary: ArticleFlow is not the Google-login runtime. PlanFlow-AppsInToss settings delegates Calendar login to CalendarSyncService; Android client/server ID and Google OAuth registration/build identity are the likely fault domain.

roles.assignment: Define safe diagnosis, minimal remediation, verification, and external authority gates.
